brief: Clear vegetation and growth encroaching on the compound fence within a metre of the radiators, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity when a unit is identified for pre-event attention [SOP-011]. Since this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event to correct all issues, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period [MG-021].
